name: Autogami Solar Toy Car – Blue Retro Renault

pages.title: Blue Retro Renault – Autogami solar toy car | Freddie & Millie Toys
pages.ld_description:
A DIY, solar-powered car: build it, decorate it, charge it, switch it on and watch it drive!

What it contains: A precut sheet of cardboard, wheel attachments, and solar/electric "Powerbase" module (polycrystalline solar panel, rechargeable battery, electric motor and gear system). Size once assembled: 9 x 4 x 5 cm
